senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נפק)to go forth.—[לפוק, Kel. XXVIII, 2; Y. Erub. III, end, 25ᵇ, v. פָּקַק.]

units: <cite ref="Eruvin 65a:5">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="Job 41:7">Job XLI, 7</cite>) <he>כל המֵפִיק מגן בשעת גאוה</he> he who foregoes the Prayer of Benedictions (v. <cite ref="M00189"><he>מָגֵן</he></cite>) in the moment of haughtiness (who being in wine has enough reverence left to him to feel his unworthiness to stand up in prayer); <he>מאי משמע דהאי אפיק לישנא דעבורי הוא</he> (Ms. O. <he>מפיק</he>) what authority is there for using the root <cite ref="Q00314"><he>פוק</he></cite> in the sense of passing? (Answ.: ref. to <cite ref="Job 6:15">Job VI, 15</cite>).

<cite ref="Job 6:15">Ib.</cite> <he>ר״י אומר כל שאינו מפיק איתמר</he> R. J. says, the relation is ‘he who does not utter’ (prayer in a state of drunkenness); <he>מאי משמע דההוא פוק לישנא דגלויי הוא</he> where is the authority for using <cite ref="Q00314"><he>פוק</he></cite> in the sense of revealing? (Answ.: ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 18:16">Ps. XVIII, 16</cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 927">Yalk. Job 927</cite>.
